scope: Ten Korean social problems; separate US cohort with same indicator definitions where available. No pooled fitting, scaling or scores.
candidate: Prior 50:50 news-direction and contextual-numeric forecast mixture remains an unvalidated FX candidate. Do not transfer coefficients or assume four equity indices are valid context for every social problem.
candidate_gate: Needs a target definition, at least ten dated evaluation outcomes, point-in-time historical vintages, domain-specific archived news and release timestamps, frozen topic/direction extraction, and appropriate contextual numeric features. Missing inputs mean NOT_EXECUTED; never substitute numeric-only output for the final mixture.
baseline_data: World Bank KOR and USA annual observations 1990-2025, source-specific ILO/WHO/UN/etc. definitions. Publication dates and historical revisions unverified; year-ordered diagnostic backtest only, not authentic historical availability simulation.
numeric_models: N0 last observed value; N1 ridge predicting next-year change from prior level, one-year change and three-year change. Fixed lambda=1, train-only standardization, no tuning. At least ten earlier complete training transitions; four consecutive input years required. Physical lower bound zero except inflation; unemployment/NEET capped at 100. Same bounds in evaluation and extrapolation.
evaluation: Target years 2016-2025 if present; no interpolation across missing years. Minimum five evaluable years to claim baseline test executed; fewer are insufficient, not failures. MAE in native units and relative to N0; never average unlike units or combine country results.
projection: Only last observation year 2025 and sufficient baseline backtest yields a conditional 2026 numerical extrapolation. Show N0 and N1, no probability interval or winner selection. Older source endpoints get no current prediction. Projections are NOT the requested final-method predictions.
selection: Ten topics chosen before looking at model scores. Regional labels reflect country-level aggregate series, not individual or local risk. The US is a separate comparator, not evidence of Korean validity.
limits: Modeled/smoothed historical series may be mechanically predictable. Lack of point-in-time data, tiny annual evaluation samples, structural changes and stale sources prevent operational claims. No clinical, investment or individual-risk decisions. No final-method success claim regardless of numeric scores.
